transcription.testTitle: Nouns, verbs and adjectives with the same form (to dream, a dream)

exercises.instruction: Label the pictures with verbs from the box.
Seven of these verbs can also be used as nouns with no change in form, and one can be used as an adjective with no change in form. Which one?
Match the verbs on the left with the nouns on the right.
items: 1 answer      4 guess      a  the dishes      d  the perfume
2 damage      5 smell      b  the phone       e  the answer
3 dry         6 push       c  the button      f  the side of the car

exercises.instruction: Which of these verbs can also be used as an adjective?
Rewrite the sentences below. Use the underlined verbs as nouns and include a verb from the box. Make any changes that are necessary. Look at the examples first.
items: Examples:  Let's walk for a bit, then rest.  Let's walk for a bit, then have a rest.
Don't brake too suddenly.  Don't put on the brakes too suddenly.

boxesAndLists: laugh    pull    taste    smile    dream    clean    queue    ache
have (×3)    give (×2)    wait    go on    send    put on
pictures: 8 numbered line drawings: girl's face, man pulling dog on lead, man holding cheek (toothache), laughing man, person dreaming of bicycle, queue of people, person washing/dog in bath, person tasting food from bowl
unclassified: Test your English Vocabulary in Use (pre-intermediate and intermediate)
